name: O. H. Holt
role: Private secretary to Governor Pierce; writer on Dakota
bio: O. H. Holt of Bismarck, private secretary to Governor Pierce, published a pamphlet on Dakota's resources in 1885. The paper praised it, though it quoted the editor's early mistake about cattle pawing through snow.

moments.label: Published a pamphlet on Dakota's resources

mentions: The Western World has an extended article concerning the natural resources of Dakota. The author, O. H. Holt, is well posted on Dakota matters, and the able manner in which he has presented the facts to the public is commendable.
